_comment: Roster of animators Khanimator works with. Captured 29 Oct 2026. Run `python build.py` after editing. Metrics drift — see the dynamic-stats note in README.
_consent: CONFIRMED 29 Oct 2026 — Moiz confirmed all listed animators have agreed to appear. Anyone added later needs the same before launch.
_privacy: Sasquatch's YouTube bio lists a personal email address and a per-cut rate. Both are deliberately NOT reproduced — republishing someone's email on a third party's commercial site invites scraping. His channel link is the contact route.
_stats: subs/videos are optional. Akk's channel hides its subscriber count, so his card omits the stats row rather than showing a zero.
